SSM.PageRefused: A challenge page can't be added to an existing journal entry. Create a challenge from the Subsystems tab.

Drop.NotAChallenge: Only challenges can go in the Subsystems tab.
Drop.ChallengeInJournal: Challenges stay in the Subsystems tab.
Drop.NormalFolder: Only challenge folders can go in the Subsystems tab.
Drop.ChallengeFolder: Challenge folders stay in the Subsystems tab.

Panel.Replaced: {name} left the panel. It is still running; right-click it in the Subsystems tab and choose Show on panel to bring it back.
Panel.PositionHint: Where the challenge panel starts at the top of the screen. Anyone can drag it by its header to a spot of their own.
Panel.NoCharacter: You need an assigned character to roll. Ask the GM to assign one.
Panel.NoGMActor: Select a token, or pick a PC under Roll as in the challenge window.
Panel.SkillGone: That check is no longer available.

Challenge.Label: Challenge
Challenge.Name: Name
Challenge.ModifierGone: That entry was deleted, so the changes were not saved.
Challenge.EndConfirm: End this challenge? The panel closes for everyone. The final state stays on the sheet.
Challenge.ResetConfirm: Return this challenge to unspent? Points, counters, rounds and reveals go back to how they were at Start.
Challenge.NotActiveGM: Another GM is running this challenge. Only the active GM can change it.
Challenge.NoPCSelected: Choose a PC to roll for.
Challenge.RollSkill: Roll {skill}, DC {dc}, for the chosen PC
Challenge.Subject: Subject
Challenge.StatLineHint: GM only. For example: Perception +12, Will +9.
Challenge.TracksPointsHint: Turn off for a subject that only holds actions.
Challenge.IndividualHint: Each PC has their own points here. A roll changes the roller's points.
Challenge.GoalHint: Reaching the goal marks the subject Complete.
Challenge.ActionGone: That action was deleted, so the changes were not saved.
Challenge.AlwaysHint: Players see this check from the start. It has no reveal control and is never a decoy.
Challenge.ActionDescriptionHint: What the action is and how players use it
Challenge.SecretHint: Rolled as a secret check, like Recall Knowledge.
Challenge.MaxPointsHint: The most this action can give in total. Blank for no limit.
Challenge.ThresholdDcHint: Applies while the threshold is reached: to this subject's checks, or to every check for a counter's threshold.
Challenge.PerRoundHint: Added when the round advances. Previous round takes it back.
Challenge.ChallengeModifiersHint: Entries for the whole challenge. A DC change applies to every check with the chosen skills, on any subject.
Challenge.ChallengeSkillsHint: Off: pick skills. The change applies to every check with those skills, on any subject.
Challenge.TrackLimits: A minimum is above its maximum, so that value was not limited.
Challenge.ReachedFollows: Reached follows the value on a track that counts both ways.
Challenge.PerPcHint: One value for each party PC. A roll changes the roller's value; a modifier changes everyone's. No thresholds or change each round.

Card.NotActiveGM: Only the active GM can apply results.
Card.ChallengeGone: This roll's challenge no longer exists.

Blocked.gone: This subject, action or check is no longer in the challenge.
Blocked.rerollAfterApply: The roll this replaced was already applied. Change points by hand on the sheet if needed.

Card.Capped: This action has reached its maximum points.
Card.AppliedDegree: Applied: {degree}. Undo it from its result card to pick again.

UndoBlocked.notRunning: The challenge isn't running, so this can't be undone.
UndoBlocked.notApplied: This result was already undone, or the challenge was reset since.

Result.Heading: {actor}: {degree} applied
Result.NoChange: No change: the values were already at their limits.

SSM.ChoosePresetHint: Pick a starting template. Everything can be edited afterwards.

Reminder.criticalFailure: Earns one false piece of information.
